changelog:
v1.11.0 Task Reminders, Interactive Checklists & Note Colors:
• Exact Offline-Safe Reminders: Exact alarm scheduling, notifications with Snooze 15m and Mark Done actions, and reboot persistence
• Interactive Checklists: 1-tap checkbox toggling (- [ ] ↔ - [x]) directly in note reading mode with haptic feedback and instant persistence
• Smart Enter Auto-Continuation: Auto-continuation of checklists in note editor and dedicated toolbar button
• Note Color Palette: 6 theme-adaptive pastel color tints for cards and note details
• Quick Filter Chips: Instant filtering on home screen by All, Reminders ⏰, Tasks ☑, and Pinned 📌
• Full offline-first sync for reminder times and note color tags
